recognition.summary: Verified, policy-compliant reports may receive requested public credit with coordinated timing and details.

reporting.summary: The official reporting section provides a direct email link.

rewards.summary: The reviewed policy does not establish a monetary reward commitment.

limitations: This is UNICEF's distinct program, not the UN Secretariat program.
The email address is protected in text extraction; use the official page's link.
Acceptance remains discretionary and subject to the linked responsible-disclosure policy.
